title: Cartwise+ Membership Order Benefits Table
content:
The order benefits of a Cartwise+ Membership are set per plan. Free delivery waives the delivery fee of an order on one of the listed services when the order's item subtotal is at or above the plan's minimum; the member service-fee rate is a percentage of the item subtotal; the Express 30 discount is a percentage off the Express 30 fee.

| Plan | Free-delivery minimum item subtotal (USD) | Services whose delivery fee is waived | Member service-fee rate | Express 30 fee discount | Small-basket fee waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 35.00 | No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery | 5.0% | 0% | no |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 35.00 | No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery | 5.0% | 0% | no |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 35.00 | No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery | 5.0% | 0% | no |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 35.00 | No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery | 5.0% | 0% | no |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 35.00 | No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery, Stock-Up Delivery | 5.0% | 25% | no |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 25.00 | No-Rush Delivery, Standard Delivery, Stock-Up Delivery | 3.5% | 50% | yes |

## Threshold illustration (hypothetical orders)

| Plan | Service | Item subtotal | Delivery fee waived? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Monthly | Standard Delivery | 35.00 | yes (at the minimum) |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | Standard Delivery | 34.99 | no (below the minimum) |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | Stock-Up Delivery | 25.00 | yes (at the minimum) |
| Cartwise+ Annual | Stock-Up Delivery | 80.00 | no (Stock-Up Delivery is not listed for this plan) |

## Notes on the table

- "At or above" includes an item subtotal exactly equal to the minimum.
- A plan whose Express 30 discount is 0% applies no discount to the Express 30 fee.
- The small-basket fee is waived only on the plan marked "yes".
